source.notes: Consolidated legacy 2020 import pack. Mechanically relevant content from the audited extraction scope is combined with stable IDs; applicable official Tasha errata dated 2021-12-13 is reconciled. Session Zero guidance and puzzles are intentionally outside this compendium extraction scope; art-only transition pages contain no materialized mechanics. Derived 2024-first compatibility projection: PHB 2024/Forge 2025 supersede reprinted content; eligible legacy subclasses are attached to the 2024 class chassis.

officialErrata.source: D&D Beyond Sage Advice & Errata - Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything

externalDependencies.policy: 2024 IDs are preferred automatically when the same stable PHB suffix exists; legacy-only references that are not required by the 2024-first profile are omitted rather than forcing PHB 2014 installation.

deduplication.versionPolicy: Legacy Tasha 2020 and later 2024/2025 rules coexist under distinct stable IDs; same-name records are not merged when payloads differ.

coverage.sessionZeroOmissionReason: Guidance/social-contract/party-origin material was outside the mechanically reusable engine-content scope used by this extraction roadmap.
coverage.puzzleOmissionReason: Puzzles, keyed puzzle solutions, and puzzle-specific traps were excluded by the current compendium policy unless a reusable subsystem had already been materialized elsewhere.

policy: PHB 2024 replaces PHB 2014 core material where a 2024 version exists.
Tasha/Xanathar subclasses, spells, and feats reprinted in PHB 2024 use the PHB 2024 version.
Tasha optional class features are not projected onto 2024 classes, except legacy-only Warlock invocations and Pact of the Talisman adapted to the 2024 invocation chassis.
Legacy subclasses without a 2024 replacement use the 2024 base class and 2024 subclass unlock timing.
Legacy species ignore species ability-score increases when used with 2024 character creation.
Forge of the Artificer 2025 supersedes the Tasha 2020 Artificer branch.

extractionNotes: Modeled as kind=species because the source explicitly uses Custom Lineage instead of choosing a race at 1st level.
No 2024 background/species conversion was applied; this remains the 2020 legacy option.
Official Tasha errata adds that the character’s race is Custom Lineage for race prerequisites.
2024 compatibility projection: species ability-score increase is ignored; ability-score increases come from the selected background.
